_lastCleanShaNote: The CLEANER's own watermark (X131) — a commit SHA, not a timestamp, and deliberately NOT lastWrapIso: they are two different clocks and reusing one for both is what conflated the cleaner's scope with the bouncer's. A sha because `git log --name-only <sha>..HEAD` is an exact range anchor, where a `--since` timestamp reads COMMIT DATE and silently skips or double-counts across a rebase, a cherry-pick or clock skew. null means NO cleaner run has completed, and the next one does a FULL sweep of src/ — that is run one, not a fallback. Advance it ONLY after a run that COMPLETED, to the HEAD sha the sweep actually read, so an aborted pass never skips a window; the cleaner cannot write state, so the dispatching chat sets it in the same turn the verdicts come back, alongside the X120 row-writing. ONLY AN UNSCOPED SWEEP ADVANCES IT (X135) — a scoped run advances nothing, because this field means all of src/ is judged up to this commit. The rule and the two sentences the chat must print are in SKILL.md's `cleaner` entry and cleaner.md C10; the 2026-08-03 scoped-run history is in ledger.jsonl.
